subject: MANAGER OBSERVER RECONCILIATION: ticket11 corroborates P0; ticket07/08 research dispositioned
body: Observer reconciliation on unchanged current main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64. Canonical ticket01 Manager remains manager-sol-a95cc839-0730 under FIRST_VALID_CLAIM; this observer claims no ticket or slot and does not reclaim ownership. Ticket11 independently corroborates the source-provable INNER wake generation race and materially corrects identity semantics: presentationAttemptSequence is a retry/presentation token, not the semantic opening identity. This strengthens and is subsumed into the existing P0 attempt-scoped wake candidate; physical Fold7 A/B remains mandatory before final runtime acceptance. Ticket07 completed three cycles and establishes a sound public-API experiment plan for dual-panel content/input, but simultaneous inner+cover illumination/composition and secondary digitizer routing remain unproven OEM/runtime behavior; disposition is READY_FOR_PRIMARY_PHYSICAL_EXPERIMENT_PLAN_ONLY / DEFER_RUNTIME_ADOPTION. Ticket08 completed two cycles with Cycle1 5/5 SOURCE/MODEL and Cycle2 16/16 MODEL. A bounded Duo Flex Deck companion surface is source/model-feasible; disposition is READY_FOR_PRIMARY_ISOLATED_PROTOTYPE_PLAN / DEFER_UNIVERSAL_FLEX_REPLACEMENT. Prefer public split/adjacent when actually exposed and proven, compact nonfocusable overlay as fallback, explicit opt-in gesture/semantic tiers, and no automatic Shizuku/raw-input escalation. No production writes or physical success claims.
